title: Other relative pronouns: whose, when, whereby
summary: Относительные слова **whose, when, where, why** и формальное **whereby**: что они заменяют, когда их можно опустить и чем заменить.
ru:
## whose — «чей, у которого»
**Whose** заменяет притяжательное слово (his, her, their, its) и стоит перед существительным. Оно относится и к людям, и к предметам, и к организациям, и **опустить его нельзя**.
> She is an artist **whose** paintings sell for millions. — Она художница, чьи картины продаются за миллионы.
> It's a company **whose** profits have fallen. — Это компания, у которой упала прибыль.
- ~~an artist whose her paintings~~ → an artist **whose** paintings (притяжательное не дублируем)
- ~~the man who's car was stolen~~ → the man **whose** car was stolen (**who's** = who is / who has)

Для вещей иногда используют **of which**: *a novel the ending of which shocked readers* — звучит книжно; нейтральнее и короче *a novel whose ending shocked readers*.

## when — после слов о времени
После **time, day, year, moment, period, week** и др. можно использовать **when** или **that**, либо ничего (в определяющих придаточных):
> That was the year **(when / that)** the factory closed. — Это был год, когда закрылась фабрика.
> I remember the day **(when)** I met her.
В поясняющем придаточном **when** обязателен: *In 1999, **when** the company was founded, there were only five employees.* — В 1999 году, когда основали компанию, в ней было всего пять сотрудников.
Но после **the first time / every time / the last time** — **that** или без слова: *This is the first time (that) I've been here.*

## where — после слов о месте и ситуации
**Where** = «in/at which»: *the café where we met, the town where she grew up*. Работает и с абстрактными «местами»: **a situation, a case, a point, a stage, a system** — *situations where it's better to stay silent; cases where the rule doesn't apply.* Книжная замена — **in which**: *the room in which the meeting took place.*
- ~~the town which I grew up~~ → the town **where** I grew up (или **in which** I grew up)

## why — после reason
**The reason why** — разговорно и обычно: *I don't know the reason (why / that) he resigned.* **Why** можно опустить. Можно и без существительного: **That's why** I called. — Вот почему я позвонил.
- ~~the reason because~~ → the reason **why / that**

## whereby — формально «посредством чего»
**Whereby** = **by which**, встречается в официальных текстах, договорах, описаниях систем и правил. Заменяет «по которой, согласно которой».
> The company introduced a scheme **whereby** employees can work from home on Fridays. — Компания ввела схему, по которой сотрудники могут работать из дома по пятницам.
- В разговорной речи вместо **whereby** обычно говорят **where / in which / under which**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~the reason where~~ → the reason **why**
- ~~the time where I was young~~ → the time **when** I was young
- ~~the man whose is tall~~ → после **whose** нужно существительное: the man **whose son** is tall
en:
## whose = 'of whom / of which'
**Whose** replaces a possessive (his, her, their, its) and comes before a noun. It refers to people, things and organisations, and **cannot be omitted**.
> She is an artist **whose** paintings sell for millions.
> It's a company **whose** profits have fallen.
- ~~an artist whose her paintings~~ → an artist **whose** paintings (don't repeat the possessive)
- ~~the man who's car was stolen~~ → the man **whose** car was stolen (**who's** = who is / who has)

For things, **of which** is also possible: *a novel the ending of which shocked readers* is bookish; *a novel whose ending shocked readers* is shorter and more natural.

## when after time words
After **time, day, year, moment, period, week** and so on, we can use **when** or **that**, or nothing at all (in defining clauses):
> That was the year **(when / that)** the factory closed.
> I remember the day **(when)** I met her.
In a non-defining clause, **when** is needed: *In 1999, **when** the company was founded, there were only five employees.*
But after **the first time / every time / the last time**, use **that** or nothing: *This is the first time (that) I've been here.*

## where after place and situation words
**Where** = 'in/at which': *the café where we met, the town where she grew up*. It also works with abstract 'places': **a situation, a case, a point, a stage, a system** — *situations where it's better to stay silent; cases where the rule doesn't apply.* The formal alternative is **in which**: *the room in which the meeting took place.*
- ~~the town which I grew up~~ → the town **where** I grew up (or **in which** I grew up)

## why after reason
**The reason why** is normal: *I don't know the reason (why / that) he resigned.* **Why** can be dropped. Without a noun: ***That's why** I called.*
- ~~the reason because~~ → the reason **why / that**

## whereby: formal 'by which'
**Whereby** = **by which**, used in official texts, contracts and descriptions of systems or rules.
> The company introduced a scheme **whereby** employees can work from home on Fridays.
- In everyday speech we prefer **where / in which / under which**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~the reason where~~ → the reason **why**
- ~~the time where I was young~~ → the time **when** I was young
- ~~the man whose is tall~~ → **whose** needs a noun: the man **whose son** is tall
structure:
## Слово → заменяет → пример
| Слово | Заменяет | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **whose** + сущ. | притяжательное (his / her / its / their) | a man **whose** car was stolen |
| **when** | in/on/at which (время) | the day **when** we met |
| **where** | in/at which (место, ситуация) | the town **where** she lives |
| **why** | for which (после reason) | the reason **why** he left |
| **whereby** | by which (формально) | a system **whereby** staff vote |

## Можно ли опустить
| Слово | Определяющее | Поясняющее |
|---|---|---|
| **whose** | нет | нет |
| **when** | да (или **that**) | нет |
| **where** | нет (можно **in which**) | нет |
| **why** | да (или **that**) | — |
| **whereby** | нет | нет |

## Формулы
> существительное + **whose** + существительное + глагол…
> the time / day / year + (**when / that**) + подлежащее + глагол…
> the place / situation / case + **where** + подлежащее + глагол…
> the reason + (**why / that**) + подлежащее + глагол…
> a system / scheme / agreement + **whereby** + подлежащее + глагол…

exercises.title: whose, when, where, why, whereby
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **whose, when, where, why** или **whereby**. Если допустимо несколько вариантов, подойдёт любой.
exercises.example: I know a man ___ brother is a pilot. → I know a man **whose** brother is a pilot.

items.text: She is an artist {{whose}} paintings sell for millions.
That was the year {{when|that}} the factory closed.
This is the café {{where|in which}} we first met.
I never understood the reason {{why|that}} he left.
The company introduced a scheme {{whereby}} staff can work from home on Fridays.
He lives in a village, {{where|in which}} there is no shop.
Do you know anyone {{whose}} car is for sale?
There are cases {{where|in which|when}} the rule doesn't apply.

exercises.title: Вставьте нужное слово
exercises.instruction: Вставьте одно слово: **whose, of, when, where, whereby, why**.

items.text: The company, {{whose}} CEO resigned yesterday, announced a restructuring.
This is the hotel, the owner {{of}} which is a famous chef.
In 2012, {{when}} the company was founded, there were only three employees.
We stayed in Kyoto, {{where}} we visited several temples.
I know a woman {{whose}} husband is an astronaut.
That is the reason {{why|that}} I called you.

items.q: She is a writer ___ books have been translated into thirty languages.
The film is set in a time ___ people had no phones.
This is the town ___ I grew up.
Nobody knows the reason ___ he resigned.
The company has a policy ___ employees can take a year off.
The man ___ car was stolen called the police.

options: The woman whose I met yesterday is a surgeon.
The woman whose daughter I met yesterday is a surgeon.
The woman whose her daughter I met is a surgeon.
items.why: **Whose** всегда сопровождается существительным и заменяет притяжательное.

options: That's the reason why he left.
That's the reason where he left.
That's the reason whose he left.

items.q: В каком предложении who's использовано верно?
options: He is the man who's car was stolen.
He is the man who's lost his keys.
He is the man who's keys lost.

items.q: Чем можно заменить where в предложении This is the house where I was born?

options: We have a system where staff choose their hours.
We have a system whereby staff choose their hours.
We have a system that staff choose their hours.

items.q: This is the first time ___ I've been here.
items.why: После **the first time** — **that** (или ничего), а не **when**.

items.q: She mentioned a place ___ we could eat cheaply.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно с помощью **whose, when, where** или **why**.

items.prompt: I know a man. His brother plays for Real Madrid.
answers: I know a man whose brother plays for Real Madrid.

items.prompt: That was the year. The factory closed then.
answers: That was the year when the factory closed.
That was the year that the factory closed.
That was the year the factory closed.

items.prompt: She works in a city. There is no public transport there.
answers: She works in a city where there is no public transport.
She works in a city in which there is no public transport.

items.prompt: This is the reason. I called you for this reason.
answers: This is the reason why I called you.
This is the reason that I called you.
This is the reason I called you.

items.prompt: The country is poor. Its economy depends on tourism.
answers: The country whose economy depends on tourism is poor.
The country, whose economy depends on tourism, is poor.

items.prompt: I remember the day. I met her then.
answers: I remember the day when I met her.
I remember the day that I met her.
I remember the day I met her.

items.prompt: (Use whereby) A system has been introduced. By this system, employees can choose their hours.
answers: A system has been introduced whereby employees can choose their hours.
A system whereby employees can choose their hours has been introduced.

items.prompt: (Use whose) It's a novel. The ending of it shocked readers.
answers: It's a novel whose ending shocked readers.
It is a novel whose ending shocked readers.

items.prompt: (Use where) There are cases. In these cases the rule doesn't apply.
answers: There are cases where the rule doesn't apply.
There are cases where the rule does not apply.

items.prompt: (Use in which) This is the room where the meeting took place.
answers: This is the room in which the meeting took place.

items.prompt: (Use when) In 1999 the company was founded. There were only five employees at that time.
answers: In 1999, when the company was founded, there were only five employees.
The company was founded in 1999, when there were only five employees.

items.prompt: (Use whose) The woman is a lawyer. I borrowed her car.
answers: The woman whose car I borrowed is a lawyer.
The woman, whose car I borrowed, is a lawyer.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя **whose, when, where, why** или **whereby**.

items.prompt: Describe a person you know whose job is unusual. Use whose.
items.sample: I have a friend whose job is to test video games.

items.prompt: Write about a time in your life you'll never forget. Use the day / the year when.
items.sample: I'll never forget the day when I moved to a new city.

items.prompt: Describe a place you love. Use where.
items.sample: There is a small cafe near my house where I like to read.

items.prompt: Explain why you study English. Use the reason why.
items.sample: The main reason why I study English is that I want to work abroad.

items.prompt: Write about a rule at your workplace or school. Use whereby.
items.sample: We have a system whereby everyone can work from home on Fridays.

items.prompt: Describe a situation in which you stay calm. Use a situation where.
items.sample: I always stay calm in situations where other people panic.
